title: Search misses zones named in the text (6 cards)
body:
- Jace's Ruse: "library and/or graveyard" searches only the library
- Counterbore and Quash: "graveyard, hand, and library" searches only the library
- Dark Supplicant, Gate to the Afterlife, Say Its Name: "graveyard, hand, and/or library" does not search the hand
